channel.title: Bhavya Lohami - Field Notes
channel.description: Original engineering notes about validation, product state, security boundaries, and trustworthy interfaces.

item.title: Displayed availability is not confirmed availability
item.description: A reliable booking flow validates time-sensitive state again at the point of commitment.

item.title: Design filters as a state model, not a drawer
item.description: Property discovery improves when filter state is understandable, reversible, and shareable.

item.title: Role-based UI is not authorization
item.description: A hidden control can simplify an interface, but only a server policy protects the operation.

item.title: Put trust boundaries in the interface
item.description: Verification, pricing, privacy, and transaction scope should appear where a user decides.
